user.title: Add a Tillerwell Hearth
user.description: Home Assistant found these boxes on your network.

manual.title: Add a Tillerwell Hearth
manual.description: No box was found automatically. Enter its address: its name ending in .local (for example hearth-a1b2c3.local) or its IP address. The box must already be on your Wi-Fi.

data_description.host: The box's name is on its setup page and in your router's list of devices.

discovery_confirm.title: Add {name}?
discovery_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a Hearth box at {host}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Hearth box at that address. Check it is powered and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.web_password_set: This box has a web password set, which is not supported. Remove the password on the box and try again.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Found a box but could not talk to it.
abort.web_password_set: This box has a web password set, which is not supported. Remove the password on the box and try again.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different box.

init.title: Tillerwell Hearth options
init.description: Pick a Home Assistant temperature sensor (for example one in the cabin) and it is sent to the box every 30 seconds. The box's thermostat uses it instead of the controller's reading while "Use external temperature" is on.

set_timers.name: Set timers
set_timers.description: Replaces the whole timer list stored on the box. Send an empty list to clear it. The box checks every rule and says why if it refuses.

timers.name: Timers
timers.description: A list of timers. Each has mode (preheat or thermostat), start (time of day), duration_min (20 to 480), and either days (mon to sun) or a one-off date. Thermostat timers also take low_c and high_c. Optional: id, enabled.

set_external_temperature.name: Set external temperature
set_external_temperature.description: Tells the box the room temperature. It is only trusted for 90 seconds, so repeat it at least that often (or pick a sensor in the integration's options instead).
